candidates.statement: The Cottingham formula expresses the leading contribution of the electromagnetic interaction to the proton- neutron mass difference as an integral over the forward Compton amplitude.
candidates.formalization_note: Science claim (analytic-derivation, evidence: in-paper — In-paper analytic derivation in sections/sec-001-abstract.md (p. 1-1)). Analytic theoretical derivation; candidate for model formalization.

candidates.statement: Their paper appeared in 1970, at a time when the origin of the ΔI = 1 mass differ- ences within the isospin multiplets was totally mysterious: evaluations of the Cottingham formula invariably led to the conclusion that the proton should be heavier than the neutron and hence unstable.
